metadata.description: Insurwreck 4.0 build kit - onboarding, credentials and read-only Plum data for participants

plugins.name: insurwreck
plugins.description: Insurwreck 4.0 onboarding: terminal or Claude app setup, registration, email verification, and credentials for Vercel, Supabase, n8n, Resend and AgentMail, plus read-only MCP servers for Plum data, Salesforce, Kula, Zendesk and CleverTap.

plugins.name: insurwreck-organizer
plugins.description: Organizer-only: publish a new Plum data slice to participants in a couple of minutes, no deploy. Needs the Metabase admin key and the desk ADMIN_KEY.
